test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following schedules vests additional discretionary powers to the Governors of Mizoram and Tripura?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6th Schedule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **6th Schedule** of the **Indian Constitution** deals with the administration of the tribal areas in the states of **Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram**.
 
• It provides for the formation of **Autonomous District Councils** and **Regional Councils** to administer these areas and safeguard the rights of the tribal population.
 
• The Governors of these states have **discretionary powers** to establish these councils and ensure that the administration is carried out according to the provisions of the 6th Schedule.
 
• These provisions are aimed at protecting the **cultural identity** and **economic interests** of the tribal people.
 
• The councils have the power to make laws on certain specified matters such as **land management, forest resources, and social customs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **4th Schedule**__

 __
 
• The **4th Schedule** of the Indian Constitution deals with the allocation of seats in the **Rajya Sabha** (Council of States) to the states and union territories.
 
• The allocation of seats is based on the population of each state and union territory.
 
 
 
• **5th Schedule**__
 __
 
• The **5th Schedule** of the Indian Constitution deals with the administration and control of **Scheduled Areas** and **Scheduled Tribes** in any state except the four states mentioned in the 6th Schedule.
 
• It also provides for the establishment of **Tribes Advisory Councils** to advise on matters pertaining to the welfare and advancement of the Scheduled Tribes.
 
 
 
• **7th Schedule**__
 
 
• The **7th Schedule** of the Indian Constitution contains the **Union List, State List,** and **Concurrent List**, which enumerate the subjects on which the Union and State Governments can legislate.
 
• The Union List contains subjects on which only the Parliament can legislate, the State List contains subjects on which only the state legislatures can legislate, and the Concurrent List contains subjects on which both the Parliament and state legislatures can legislate.
